why: The Rindo Hotel is the abandoned, unfinished hotel on Elizabeth Kress Street in Dogtown. Squatters have occupied different parts of it for years: a camp on the lower floors and the ruined 8th-floor rooms, one of which held a generator built from a Thorton engine. This proposal restores the ground-floor squat camp (the eight ambient homeless entries), the hideout's residents (Jacob Long, Taylor Gibbs, two more squatters and the ambient Mia) and the lit, pre-safehouse interior. Myers, Reed, BARGHEST and the Cynosure crew are left out because the crash and the chase that bring them there never happen.

open_questions: No community area/spot map resolved for this venue: all 51 community options have spots 0 and posture unknown, and none list workspots. Every choice here needs the dev tour (rule 9); in particular whether the #q302_com_squot default entries seat on the loc_q302_squat_openworld_prefabUR6VS5I/#homeless_spot_001_* spots.

q302_squat_persistent_content.questphase activates six #q302_hobos entries that do not exist in the community registry (q302_hobo_f_2..f_5, q302_hobo_m_4, q302_hobo_m_5, all 'default'), and a 'peace_fix' phase that no entry defines. They look like cut content; I used only entries/phases the registry actually defines. Confirm none of them is meant to exist.

Which door is #q302_dvc_squot_door: the 8th-floor hideout door or the hotel entrance? The wiki gives two street entrances (Pacific Boulevard, Elizabeth Kress Street); the tour should check the anchor's position and that the normal way in is passable.
peace_no_fix is the only calm phase for the two talking hobos; the tour should confirm their workspots are sit/lean/talk and not a leftover of the oath standoff.

The subway route prefab #q302_pr_subway is a q302_04 phasePrefab but is not in this venue's catalogue prefab list, so it is not restored. Is the hotel reachable on foot from the Dogtown street entrances without it?

The q302_07_oath lighting set also names q302_04_squot_ground_floor_community and q302_squat's squat_lights_to_turn_on, but neither variant is registered in all.streamingblock; I left them out. If the ground-floor camp still looks unlit on tour, those stale names are the first thing to investigate.

communities.why: A pair of squatters chilling in the camp; this entry has both a male and a female record and vanilla never activates it, so the camp is empty in the clean slate.
Ambient camp squatter; vanilla defines the entry and phase but never activates it.
A squatter eating at the camp; baked ambient entry, never activated by vanilla.
Second camp kitchen/ablution routine for the same squat camp; baked entry, never activated by vanilla.
Camp musician (handpan); a deliberately non-hostile, seated/loitering ambient entry that never runs under vanilla.
Squatter warming herself at the camp fire/barrel; the fire is part of the ground-floor camp the building has in lore.
Camp preacher; ambient standing/talking entry, never activated by vanilla.
Squatter asleep in the camp; ambient sleeping entry, never activated by vanilla.

Jacob Long, the squatter who lives in the 8th-floor hideout; q302's persistent-content phase already uses this relaxed squat phase when no quest is running, and the wiki lists him as an occupant of the building.

Taylor Gibbs (the second squatter, internal record q302_james; the taylor_* phases drive this entry) watching the hideout door, the ambient state the persistent-content phase uses before the quest starts.
A resident woman talking in the hideout; peace_no_fix is the only calm, non-ambush, non-dead phase this entry defines, so it is the closest to normal occupancy.
A resident man talking in the hideout; peace_no_fix is the only calm phase beside militia/ambush for this entry.

Mia is a baked ambient street-story civilian attached to this squat's persistent-content prefab; vanilla defines her default phase but never activates it, so she adds one more neighbour without inventing anyone.

variant_toggles.why: The squat's default state is the power-cut lighting from q302_04 (q302_04_squot = 1 by default). This reproduces the lit, generator-repaired, community-present state vanilla uses in q302_07_oath, with the quest's blue mood light and the after-quest/aftermath state off. The stale variant name q302_04_squot_ground_floor_community was dropped because it is not registered in all.streamingblock.

Generic squatter decoration for the pre-safehouse room, exactly the pair q302_04 applies when V first enters. It keeps the apartment a squatted ruin instead of the after-story safehouse (var_q302_post_safehouse) or the mq300 community takeover.

proximity_wait.why: The squat/hideout door vanilla drives in q302_04 and mq300; a real DoorControllerPS with a resolved path in the building's device section, on the normal way into the populated rooms.
